pin.longFormSummary:
A LEGO-themed family hotel beside LEGOLAND Malaysia, with themed rooms, a separate children’s sleeping area and in-room treasure hunts.

Family stay

The operator’s Kingdom room page says rooms sleep a family of five and include a separate children’s sleeping area. Theme park admission and other inclusions depend on the package booked.

Budget and booking

The operator advertises Kingdom rooms starting at RM679. The page does not establish a date-specific all-in quote; confirm taxes, fees, occupancy and park tickets when booking. This is a local-currency nightly room-rate observation, not construction cost.

Compare the complete stay cost and verify tickets, transport schedules and occupancy before booking.

A value-focused Shin-Urayasu hotel with colourful rooms, family room configurations and a free shuttle to Tokyo Disney Resort.

Family stay

The operator lists rooms with four or five beds, and a free shuttle connects with the Disney parks. It is a bus-based stay rather than a hotel at the park gates. Check the current shuttle schedule before travelling.

Budget and booking

The independent firsthand review recommends this hotel for keeping costs down. Current room rates vary with dates and occupancy; obtain a live quote from Accor. Breakfast, parking and the room configuration affect the complete stay cost.

pin.longFormSummary:
A value-category Disney hotel in Shin-Urayasu, with Disney-themed rooms and lobbies and shuttle buses to Tokyo Disneyland and Tokyo DisneySea.

Family stay

Wish opened on June 1, 2016 and Discover followed on September 10, 2016. The buildings converted the former Palm & Fountain Terrace Hotel. A firsthand review describes rooms sleeping up to four and a park shuttle taking about 20 minutes. It is farther from the parks than the hotels at their entrances.

Budget and booking

The operator positions Celebration as a value-type Disney hotel, and the independent review recommends it for a lower-budget Disney-themed stay. No reliable current nightly room quote was verified. Check a date-specific quote; value category does not guarantee a low holiday rate or included park tickets.

Compare the complete stay cost and verify tickets, transport schedules and occupancy before booking.

The date on this pin is the Wish building’s Disney rebranding opening, June 1, 2016; it is not the opening of the earlier hotel.

pin.longFormSummary:
A design-led midscale hotel near Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa, with a pool, family-friendly room options and a self-service laundrette.

Family stay

The operator’s room selector limits a standard room to two adults and one child aged 4–16. For larger families, request connecting rooms and confirm availability. The hotel has an outdoor pool, gym and self-service laundry.

Budget and booking

The National’s property review describes Rove’s affordable midscale positioning. Obtain a fresh hotel quote and confirm taxes, the Tourism Dirham fee and any breakfast charge.

Compare the complete stay cost and verify tickets, transport schedules and occupancy before booking.

Rove Downtown opened on May 4, 2016, according to Rove COO Paul Bridger’s interview in BOTT’s May–June 2022 issue (page 39).
